title: What carries the load in an all-fibre-lined bogie-hearth tempering furnace?
summary: Fibre hearth insulation does not mean the fibre carries workpiece weight. Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd.'s bogie-hearth tempering proposal signed 1 March 2021 adds transverse I-section supports and load-bearing columns within the fibre lining, with column feet bearing on longitudinal/transverse frame beams. For wide-bogie loads, identify the force path first, then assess insulation and circulation around it.
